title: Trophic Levels and the 10% Law
summary: Producers, consumers and decomposers, trophic levels, and why energy flow is one-way.
objectives: I can assign organisms to trophic levels.
I can explain why energy flow is one-way.
misconceptions: Energy is recycled in an ecosystem like nutrients.
Top predators have the most energy.
Decomposers are not part of the ecosystem.
